ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.

6. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of water? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of water.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of water.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of water.

8. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sounds that alert us? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Sounds that alert us.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sounds that alert us.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sounds that alert us.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.

11. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmful effects of? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Harmful effects of.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmful effects of.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmful effects of.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmful effects of.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Harmful effects of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping safe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. D — Ice melting to water

2. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.

3. C — 100 °C

4. C — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

5. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.

6. D — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

7. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.

8. D — Glucose and oxygen

9. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.

10. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.

11. D — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

12. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmful effects of.
